scenario_name: Operation Red Nile - African Financial Sector Intrusion

stages.description: Attacker leverages compromised credentials of user 'administrator' over VPN connection at 10:42:03 EAT.
Spawns hidden powershell.exe with base64 encoded download cradle targeting in-memory reflective loader.
HTTPS beaconing established to 185.220.101.5 on port 443 with randomized jitter (15-30 seconds).
Attacker attempts to extract plaintext domain hashes using in-memory Mimikatz reflection.
